snippet.title: Path to Tamer Town - Announcement Game Trailer
snippet.description:
The journey begins – this is the official Announcement Trailer for Path to Tamer Town!
Travel from city to city in a roguelite, procedurally generated adventure. Catch and evolve your team of Mokitons, face tough choices, and battle in a unique system that blends real-time action with turn-based tactics – all leading to the final showdown at the Stadium.

➡️ Wishlist now on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3939760/Path_to_Tamer_Town/

_______
Path to Tamer Town takes place in the same universe as Tamer Town – our monster-taming city builder where tamers and creatures live and grow together. Discover the beginning of the story here, and see how it continues in Tamer Town!
➡️ Check out Tamer Town on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3601860/Tamer_Town/

First revealed during Monster Tamer Direct.
